notes.routeMeasurement: Component-scope measurement of the value-stream strip on /admin/twin-kit with pet-rescue's real composed stage flow (ValueStreamStrip.budget.test.tsx, lib/ux-budget measureUxBudget + axe-core in jsdom). Every stage inline: 99 words on arrival. Inherited backbone stages deferred behind the disclosure: 82 words, 1 disclosure region, 0 axe violations. The first CI sweep of this branch measured the whole route at 508 words with the inline strip against a frozen 479; the deferred strip removes the five inherited tiles and their untracked markers from what is visible on arrival. The CI route sweep remains the authoritative route-level figure and blocks if this measurement is wrong.
notes.responsiveFit: The strip keeps its horizontal overflow container; the disclosure is a native details element below it with a caption-sized summary, so nothing changes at narrow widths beyond one extra line.
notes.themeAndAccess: Inherited stages keep the same tiles, labels, load-bearing accent and untracked marker inside the disclosure; the summary uses the accent token; axe reports zero violations with color contrast excluded in jsdom.
